### **Position Description \& Qualifications**

  

  

If you’re looking for a high\-profile, challenging opportunity supporting the U.S. Navy, Serco has an exciting opportunity for you. This position will join a dynamic team supporting Team Submarine. Bring your expertise, technical skills, and collaborative approach to a mission\-critical role that helps advance U.S. national security and the safety and effectiveness of our Sailors.


**Ability to obtain U.S. Department of War (DoW) Secret security clearance.**


About the Program


Program Executive Office Submarines, Program Manager for the Virginia\-Class Submarine (PMS 450\), is responsible for the acquisition of the U.S. Navy’s Virginia\-Class nuclear\-powered attack submarines. PMS 450 identifies, assembles, manages, directs, and coordinates the resources required for research and development, design, construction, Test and Evaluation (T\&E), Live Fire Test and Evaluation (LFT\&E), and fleet introduction.


PMS 450 is responsible for developing and deploying an affordable, nuclear\-powered attack submarine with multi\-mission capabilities and enhanced performance in littoral environments. Virginia\-Class submarines support five of the Navy’s six core maritime capabilities: Deterrence, Maritime Security, Sea Control, Forward Presence, and Power Projection.

  



The Opportunity


Serco is seeking an Onboarding and Systems Specialist to manage the end\-to\-end integration of personnel and streamline administrative workflows for the U.S. Navy’s Team Submarine organization, specifically supporting the Virginia\-Class Submarine Program at the Washington Navy Yard in Washington, DC.


In this role, you will oversee onboarding and offboarding processes for civilian, military, and contractor personnel while serving as a primary administrator for Microsoft SharePoint and Microsoft Power Platform automated workflows. You will help modernize administrative processes, improve workforce visibility, and develop digital solutions that increase efficiency across the program.


This is an excellent opportunity to join our team and contribute to the delivery of cutting\-edge undersea warfare capabilities for the U.S. Navy.

  



What You’ll Do


* Manage the end\-to\-end onboarding and offboarding lifecycle for civilian, military, and contractor personnel assigned to the Virginia\-Class Submarine Program, ensuring a seamless transition into and out of the organization.
* Maintain, configure, and continuously improve the program’s onboarding systems, databases, and portal pages hosted on Microsoft SharePoint.
* Design, develop, test, implement, and maintain custom Microsoft Power Apps and Power Automate workflows to streamline manual routing, data entry, approvals, notifications, and other administrative processes.
* Collaborate with adjacent Team Submarine program offices to support their onboarding operations, share best practices, and expand successful automation solutions across the organization.
* Coordinate with security managers, IT support teams, facilities personnel, and sponsor representatives to ensure timely provisioning of physical workspaces, Common Access Cards (CACs)/badges, network accounts, computer equipment, and other required resources.
* Maintain accurate personnel rosters, onboarding records, and historical staffing data.
* Develop metrics, dashboards, and reports to support workforce planning, program reviews, and leadership decision\-making.
* Identify opportunities to improve administrative processes through automation, standardization, and digital transformation.

Provide user support and troubleshooting for SharePoint\-based onboarding tools and automated workflows.  
* 

Required Qualifications


* Bachelor’s degree in information systems, business management, computer science, or a related field and minimum 8 years of relevant experience in business process analysis, workflow automation, SharePoint administration, Microsoft Power Platform solutions, or a related discipline. Equivalent combinations of education and experience may be considered.
* **Ability to obtain and maintain a DoW Secret security clearance.**
* Demonstrated experience building and managing Microsoft SharePoint sites, including custom lists, libraries, pages, and site structures.
* Hands\-on experience designing and implementing workflows using Microsoft Power Automate.
* Hands\-on experience developing applications using Microsoft Power Apps.
* Strong organizational and project coordination skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
* Ability to communicate effectively with technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to travel approximately 10% of the time.

Desired Qualifications


* Experience supporting personnel onboarding, workforce operations, or administrative processes within a DoD/Navy acquisition program office, Program Executive Office (PEO), or Navy command environment.
* Experience gathering and translating requirements from non\-technical stakeholders into intuitive, user\-friendly digital forms, applications, and workflows.
* Demonstrated ability to identify administrative bottlenecks, analyze complex operational processes, and develop and implement digital solutions that improve efficiency.
* Experience developing SharePoint\-based dashboards, reporting tools, or workforce tracking solutions.
* Familiarity with Microsoft 365 and the broader Microsoft Power Platform ecosystem.
* Exceptional organizational, interpersonal, and communication skills, with the ability to coordinate effectively across military, civilian, contractor, and government organizations.
* Ability to work independently while also collaborating effectively within a diverse, mission\-focused team.
  

  

### **Company Overview**

  

  

Serco Inc. (Serco) is the Americas division of Serco Group, plc. In North America, Serco’s 9,000\+ employees strive to make an impact every day across 100\+ sites in the areas of Defense, Citizen Services, and Transportation. We help our clients deliver vital services more efficiently while increasing the satisfaction of their end customers. Serco serves every branch of the U.S. military, numerous U.S. Federal civilian agencies, the Intelligence Community, the Canadian government, state, provincial and local governments, and commercial clients. While your place may look a little different depending on your role, we know you will find yours here. Wherever you work and whatever you do, we invite you to discover your place in our world. Serco is a place you can count on and where you can make an impact because every contribution matters.

Please note, due to EEOC/OFCCP compliance, Serco is unable to accept resumes by email.
  

  

Candidates may be asked to present proof of identity during the selection process. If requested, this will require presentation of a government\-issued I.D. (with photo) with name and address that match the information entered on the application. Serco will not take possession of or retain/store the information provided as proof of identity. For more information on how Serco uses your information, please see our Applicant Privacy Policy and Notice.

### **Pay Transparency**

  

  

Our Total Rewards package includes competitive pay, performance\-based incentives, and benefits that promote well\-being and work\-life balance—so you can thrive both professionally and personally. Eligible employees also gain access to a wide range of benefits from comprehensive health coverage and health savings accounts to retirement plans, life and disability insurance, and time\-off programs that support work\-life balance. To review all Serco benefits please visit: https://careers.serco\-na.com/us/en/about\-us.

jobs.title: Cash Management Relationship & Implementation Specialist
jobs.description:
**SUMMARY OF POSITION**



The Business Banking Cash Management Relationship and Implementation Specialist has a working knowledge of the products and services designed for business customers and serves as a resource to the Manager of Business Banking Product Services, Development and Implementation and Loan Officers by providing professional, courteous and efficient customer service to the Bank's business customers. The incumbent serves as a technical resource for business customers and Bank colleagues, providing expertise in Business Online Banking, ACH Origination, Positive Pay, Remote Deposit Capture, Wire Transfers, Merchant Services, and related cash management technologies. The position works closely with Relationship Managers, Branch Managers, DSRs, and Retail Banking personnel to identify business banking opportunities, deepen customer relationships, and promote the Bank’s products and services. Responsible for managing sales and referral reporting, proactively identifying opportunities for new business relationships, account expansion, and product penetration among existing and prospective customers. This position serves as a key liaison between Retail Banking and Business Banking, providing consultative support to retail teams and business customers while helping achieve the Bank’s growth and relationship development objectives. Excellent time management, prioritizing, multi\-tasking, and communication skills are required in this customer contact position.

  


**PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES**


**Essential Functions**


* Partner with Manager of Business Banking\-Product Services, Development and Implementation
* Account opening, closing, cash management services onboarding, ongoing servicing of accounts, and merchant services for new and existing clients
* Perform a variety of routine daily tasks; prepare reports and participate in special department projects as requested
* Partner with Relationship Managers, Branch Managers, and Deposit Service Representatives (DSRs) to identify, pursue, and onboard new business banking relationships.
* Actively support business development efforts by assisting in the conversion of prospective business customers and the migration of full operating account relationships to the Bank.
* Develop and maintain strong working relationships with retail banking teams to promote business products and services, identify opportunities, and provide consultative support for business bankers.
* Consult with business customers to evaluate operational and cash management needs, recommend appropriate banking products and services, troubleshoot technical and operational issues, and provide implementation, training, and ongoing support for cash management platforms.
* Develop trusted relationships that promote customer retention, product adoption, and growth of the overall banking relationship.
* Serve as a technical resource for customers and Bank colleagues by troubleshooting software, connectivity, system access, file transmission, and cash management platform issues. Assist customers with setup, implementation, training, and ongoing support for Business Online Banking, ACH Origination, Positive Pay, Remote Deposit Capture, Wire Transfers, Merchant Services, and related products.
* Utilize technical knowledge to diagnose and resolve customer issues related to hardware, software, internet browsers, mobile applications, file imports and exports, and third\-party integration platforms. Escalate when appropriate and coordinate resolution with internal and external support teams.
* Proactively manage and utilize assigned referral and sales tracking reports to identify business banking opportunities, coordinate outreach efforts, and document sales activities and outcomes.
* Help in the coordination and support of audits and examinations
* Monitor and work deposit exceptions to ensure all items are resolved within established guidelines
* Meet and exceed customer satisfaction through the successful resolution of customer questions/concerns within given authority
* Additional responsibilities may be assigned in the position


**Secondary Functions**


* Support branch and retail sales initiatives by providing knowledge, training, and guidance related to business banking services and cash management solutions.
* Contribute to the achievement of departmental growth objectives through referral generation, customer retention, and expansion of existing business relationships.
* Complete required training including regulatory, systems and others as required by the Bank and/or supervisor based on job duties within the requested time periods
* Seek opportunities to support volunteerism in local community events, increase the Bank's outreach and foster new business
* Continually evaluate processes and procedures to effectively use technology for efficiencies and accuracy of the Business Banking team

  


**KNOWLEDGE, SKILL, AND ABILITY REQUIREMENTS**


**Education And/or Experience**



To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential job requirement satisfactorily and a skills inventory is listed below. A high school diploma or general education degree (GED) is required with related experience and secondary education preferred. Sales experience, business development experience, or experience working directly with business customers is strongly preferred. The successful candidate must possess the ability to identify sales opportunities, develop customer relationships, and effectively promote business banking products and services. Strong consultative selling, relationship management, and customer engagement skills are required. Business Banking knowledge, Business Online Banking, ACH Origination, Remote Deposit Capture, Positive Pay, Wire Transfers, and Mobile Banking is highly preferred. Successful completion of required background checks is required.



Position level will commensurate with knowledge, experience, and education.


**Compliance Knowledge**



Ability to demonstrate general knowledge of the Bank Secrecy Act/USA Patriot Act, Privacy laws and regulations, as well as any applicable consumer protection laws and regulations.



General knowledge of information security is required. This includes understanding the importance of safekeeping confidential customer information, understanding and acknowledgement of Bank policies in relation to information security, and maintaining safety in the Bank’s network.


**Language Skills**



Must possess exceptional communication skills including:


* Ability to produce effective communications (e.g. reports, forms, and correspondence).
* Ability to speak effectively and build strong working relationships with colleagues and customers (and potential customers) of the Bank.


**Equipment/Tools Skills**



The employee must be proficient with standard office equipment.



Computer skills required must be proficient in Microsoft Office products, email, and internet. Prior experience or the ability to learn core transaction systems and any other computer programs pertinent to performing job duties.


**Mathematical Skills**



Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide using whole numbers, common fractions, and decimals. Must have the ability to balance and make mathematical computations with accuracy. Strong attention to detail is required.


**Reasoning Ability**



Ability to apply common sense understanding to issues and carry out written or oral instructions (both simple and complex). Ability to handle multiple tasks simultaneously.

  


**PHYSICAL DEMANDS**



When performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently required to sit; and to use hands to finger, handle, or touch. The employee may occasionally lift and/or move up to 10 pounds.

  


**WORK ENVIRONMENT/LOCATION**



The noise level in the work environment is low to moderate.



The employee in this position will be required to work in an indoor environment and come in direct contact with staff and customers.



The primary work location for this position is 920 Peach Street, Erie, PA 16501\. Regular travel is required to Marquette Savings Bank branch locations throughout Erie and Crawford Counties to support business banking, cash management, implementation, and customer service activities. Travel to business customer locations is also required to conduct consultations, assist with onboarding and implementation, provide training, troubleshoot services, and strengthen customer relationships.


***This class specification should not be interpreted as all\-inclusive. It is intended to identify the essential functions and*** ***requirements*** ***of this job. Individuals may be requested to perform job\-related responsibilities and tasks other than those stated in this specification. Any essential function or requirement of this class will be evaluated as necessary should an individual be unable to perform the function or requirement due to a disability as defined by the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA). Reasonable accommodation for the specific disability will be made for the individual when possible.***


***Marquette Savings Bank is a 119\-year\-old financial institution headquartered in Erie, PA with branch offices throughout Erie and Crawford Counties.*** ***Marquette is an Equal Opportunity Employer, and we actively recruit, and seek to hire, retain, and promote a diverse workforce; we are an equal opportunity employer of protected veterans and individuals with disabilities.***

jobs.description:
Paylocity is an award\-winning provider of cloud\-based HR and payroll software solutions, offering the most complete platform for the modern workforce. The company has become one of the fastest\-growing HCM software providers worldwide by offering an intuitive, easy\-to\-use product suite that helps businesses automate and streamline HR and payroll processes, attract and retain talent, and build a strong workplace culture.


While traditional HR and payroll providers automate basic HR processes such as payroll and benefits administration, Paylocity goes further by developing tools that HR and businesses need to compete for talent and deliver against the expectations of the modern workforce.


We give our employees what they need to succeed, including great benefits and perks! We offer medical, dental, vision, life, disability, and a 401(k) match, as well as perks that support you, your family, and your finances. And if it’s career development you desire, we provide that, too! At Paylocity, people matter most and have always been at the heart of our business.


Help our award\-winning technology company run effectively as you take on big challenges and find solutions with a position in Operations.


Use your problem\-solving skills to shape the way others see Paylocity. Launch your career with us!

**In\-Office:** This is a 100% in\-office role based at our Meridian, ID; Schaumburg, IL; or Rochester, NY location. Remote or hybrid work is not available for this position. Candidates must be able to work on\-site five days per week during designated work hours.

**Position Overview**


This role is responsible for supporting client implementations with a strong focus on data migration, validation, and test payroll execution. This role involves collaborating closely with Sales, Data Conversion, Implementation, and Managed Services teams to ensure successful project outcomes and identify opportunities for additional services. The consultant plays a key role in onboarding client data, driving projects to completion, and ensuring go\-live dates are met.

**Primary Responsibilities**

* Collaborate internally with Sales, Implementation, and Managed Services teams to ensure successful project outcomes
* Drive projects to completion, ensuring go\-live dates are met
* Play a key role in onboarding client data during the implementation process
* Proactively overcoming challenges

**Education and Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree required or equivalent experience
* 1\+ years of Payroll experience required
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, especially Excel. Advanced Excel skills including pivot tables, VLOOKUP, data manipulation, and analysis
* Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and prioritize tasks effectively
* Certified Payroll Professional (CPP) certification is a plus
* Strong interpersonal skills and ability to work effectively in a team environment
* Demonstrate organizational and time management abilities
* Excellent decision\-making, analytical, and problem\-solving skills with high attention to detail.
* A solid understanding of payroll compliance at the federal, state, and local levels
* Ability to communicate clearly with clients and provide excellent customer service

**Physical requirements**

* Ability to sit for extended periods: The role requires sitting at a desk or workstation for long periods, typically 7\-8 hours a day.
* Use of computer and phone systems: The employee must be able to operate a computer, use phone systems, and type. This includes using multiple software programs and inquiries simultaneously

**Paylocity is an equal\-opportunity employer**. Paylocity is committed to the full inclusion of all individuals. We recruit, train, compensate, and promote regardless of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, disability, age, veteran status, and other protected


status as required by applicable law. At Paylocity, we believe diversity makes us better. We embrace and encourage our employees’ differences in age, culture, ethnicity, family or marital status, gender identity or expression, language, national origin, physical and mental ability, political affiliation, race, religion or spiritual belief, sexual orientation, socio\-economic status, veteran status, and other characteristics that make our employees unique. We actively cultivate these differences through our employee


resource groups (ERGs), employee experiences, perspectives, talents, and approaches to drive innovation in the software and services we provide our customers. We comply with federal and state disability laws and make reasonable accommodations for applicants and employees with disabilities. To request reasonable accommodation in the job application or interview process, please contact LeaveBenefits@paylocity.com. This email address is exclusively designated for such requests, aligning with federal and state disability laws. Please do not send resumes to this email address, as they will be removed.


The base pay range for this position is $26/hour; however, base pay offered may vary depending on job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. This position offers a full range of benefits outlined here. jobs.title: Director, Client Onboarding & Implementation
jobs.description:
We're seeking a Director, Client Onboarding \& Implementation to lead the team that will work with internal and external stakeholders to onboard and launch Included Health clients. You will lead a team of managers that support implementation \& operations team members to bring our client contracts to reality. You will collaborate with leaders in sales, client success, operations, product, marketing, legal and finance to evolve processes and infrastructure, including optimization of implementation workflows, playbooks and other related systems. Your data\-driven insights and leadership on strategic \& operational initiatives will help influence the growth trajectory of Included Health and allow us to resolve the most important strategic and operational issues facing the business.The right individual must be able to manage multiple competing priorities and adapt to change in a fast\-paced and continually evolving environment.  



We’re seeking a Director, Implementation to lead the people, operating model, and portfolio delivery disciplines that bring Included Health client commitments to life. This leader will manage and develop Implementation Consultants and Implementation Project Managers, oversee complex client launches, and create the governance, and cross\-functional operating practices needed to deliver consistent, high\-quality outcomes. The role partners closely with Sales, Client Success, Product, Engineering/Systems, Operations, Clinical, and other leaders to improve launch readiness, resolve critical issues, and scale implementation capabilities as the business evolves.  



The ideal candidate combines strong team leadership with deep implementation judgment. They can move between executive\-level client and internal conversations, portfolio\-level risks and tradeoffs, and the operating mechanisms that help implementation teams execute effectively. They should be comfortable using implementation and client\-performance metrics to identify patterns and prioritize action, without needing to be an advanced data analyst.  


### **People Leadership \& Organizational Capacity**


* Lead, develop, and retain a high\-performing organization of implementation leaders, consultants, project managers, and related client\-facing professionals.
* Set clear expectations for delivery quality, client experience, collaboration, and accountability; provide coaching, performance management, and career development.
* Build leadership capacity through succession planning, mentoring, and development of future people leaders.
* Partner with leadership on staffing, capacity planning, workload distribution, and seasonal readiness across the implementation portfolio.

### **Portfolio Delivery \& Launch Outcomes**


* Oversee end\-to\-end implementation delivery across the your team’s portfolio, ensuring appropriate strategy, resourcing, governance, and execution for standard, complex, and transformational launches.
* Establish clear expectations for launch readiness, quality, on\-time delivery, post\-launch stability, and client transition.
* Ensure teams identify dependencies, manage scope and timelines, and maintain clear ownership of critical deliverables and decisions.
* Review portfolio health and intervene early when risks, capacity constraints, or execution issues threaten client or business outcomes.

### **Client Governance \& Executive Escalations**


* Establish effective governance models, operating rhythms, escalation paths, and decision\-making practices for complex implementations.
* Serve as the escalation point for implementation risks and client issues with strategic, commercial, operational, or reputational implications.
* Build trust through transparent communication, sound judgment, clear recommendations, and consistent follow\-through.

### **Implementation Methodology, Quality \& Continuous Improvement**


* Use retrospectives, implementation learnings, client feedback, and performance trends to identify systemic gaps and prioritize improvements.
* Establish quality controls and adoption mechanisms that improve consistency, reduce avoidable escalations, and increase team efficiency.
* Ensure improvements are translated into practical guidance, enablement, and repeatable ways of working for implementation teams.

### **Cross\-Functional Operating Model**


* Align Sales, Client Success, Product, Engineering/Systems, Operations, Clinical, and other partners around implementation priorities, dependencies, decisions, and client outcomes.
* Surface recurring themes and implementation constraints to inform product, process, staffing, and business decisions.
* Clarify ownership and drive resolution when work crosses organizational boundaries or existing processes are insufficient.

### **Product, Technical \& Operational Readiness**


* Maintain sufficient product, systems, integration, and operational fluency to guide implementation strategy and challenge assumptions effectively.
* Partner with Product, Engineering/Systems, Care, Clinical, and Support leaders to ensure technology feeds, integrations, claims readiness, operational processes, and member\-support pathways are prepared for launch.
* Ensure client requirements are translated into feasible implementation approaches while balancing client needs, operational sustainability, and scalable delivery.
* Support the development of tools and reporting that improve visibility into readiness, risks, dependencies, and portfolio performance without taking on day\-to\-day project administration.

### **Client Transition \& Post\-Launch Partnership**


* Partner with Client Success and operational leaders to ensure a clear transition from implementation to ongoing client ownership.
* Monitor early post\-launch performance and ensure material issues have clear owners, communication plans, and durable resolutions.
* Use implementation outcomes and client feedback to strengthen retention, advocacy, and future growth opportunities.

### **Required Qualifications**


* 8\+ years of progressive experience in SaaS implementation, client onboarding, implementation consulting, program management, or project management; 10\+ years preferred.
* 3\+ years of experience leading and developing client\-facing implementation or project management professionals, including managers where applicable.
* Proven experience leading complex, multi\-workstream implementations involving significant cross\-functional dependencies, technical integrations, operational readiness, and executive stakeholders.
* Demonstrated ability to lead both strategic implementation consulting and disciplined project/program execution, either directly or through a blended team of consultants and project managers.
* Proven experience managing risks and escalations, improving quality, and delivering predictable, high\-quality launches.
* Demonstrated executive presence and client leadership skills, including the ability to facilitate senior\-level governance forums, navigate difficult conversations, and build alignment across competing priorities.
* Track record of building scalable implementation methodologies, playbooks, standards, and operating processes that improve consistency, quality, client experience, and team efficiency.
* Strong cross\-functional leadership skills and experience influencing Sales, Client Success, Product, Engineering/Systems, Operations, Clinical, and other partners toward shared client and business outcomes.
* Experience in healthcare, employee benefits, health technology, or a closely related ecosystem, with the ability to understand client, carrier, partner, and operational requirements.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and experience.

### **Preferred Qualifications**


* Experience with healthcare benefits administration, claims operations, carrier ecosystems, or related healthcare data/integration environments.
* Experience leading organizational change management or operating\-model changes.
* PMP, CSM, or another relevant project/program management certification.
* Experience using Salesforce, Cloud Coach, Jira, or similar systems to manage implementation portfolios, capacity, risks, and delivery performance.
* Working fluency with operational and client\-performance metrics, dashboards, and trend analysis to identify risks, prioritize improvements, and support decisions; advanced data analytics experience is not required.
* Experience mentoring leaders, building succession pipelines, and creating a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.
*The base salary range for this full\-time position is $163,830 – $250,668 per year in the United States. This posted range reflects the portion of our internal salary band that is currently funded for new hires in this role across our standard labor markets (Zones A–C).*  


*For context, these markets include Zone A (e.g., Phoenix AZ, San Antonio TX, Columbus OH, Charlotte NC), Zone B (e.g., Chicago IL, Denver CO, San Diego CA, Houston TX), and Zone C (e.g., Los Angeles CA, Seattle WA, Washington, D.C., Boston MA). At this time, we are not budgeting for hires in higher\-cost Zone D markets (e.g., San Francisco Bay Area CA, New York City NY, San Jose CA) for this role. Within this range, individual pay is determined by work location, skills, experience, and internal equity. We use structured salary bands and geographic zones based on cost of labor to keep pay fair and consistent.*  


**Benefits \& Perks:**
*In addition to receiving a great compensation package, the compensation package may include, depending on the role, the following and more:*
*Bonus*
*Equity*
*Remote\-first culture*
*401(k) savings plan through Fidelity*
*Comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage through multiple medical plan options (including disability insurance)*
*Paid Time Off ("PTO") and Discretionary Time Off (“DTO")*
*12 weeks of 100% Paid Parental leave*
*Family Building \& Compassionate Leave: Fertility coverage, $25,000 for surrogacy/adoption, and paid leave for failed treatments, adoption or pregnancies.*
*Work\-From\-Home reimbursement to support team collaboration home office work*  


*Your recruiter will share more about the salary range and benefits package for your role during the hiring process.* **About Included Health**  

Included Health is a new kind of healthcare company, delivering integrated virtual care and navigation. We’re on a mission to raise the standard of healthcare for everyone. We break down barriers to provide high\-quality care for every person in every community — no matter where they are in their health journey or what type of care they need, from acute to chronic, behavioral to physical. We offer our members care guidance, advocacy, and access to personalized virtual and in\-person care for everyday and urgent care, primary care, behavioral health, and specialty care. It’s all included. Learn more at**includedhealth.com****.**\-
Included Health is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, orientation, national origin, age, disability, genetics or any other basis forbidden under federal, state, or local law. Included Health considers all qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records in accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, and California law.

Included Health uses AI\-assisted tools at select stages of the hiring process to enhance efficiency, consistency, and communication. AI does not make hiring decisions—final decisions are made exclusively by our recruiting and hiring teams.
